probes.name: three-cache-refresh-1
probes.source:
Function Prop(o As Object,k As String) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim v As Variant
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
Prop=TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
Exit Function
Failed:
Prop="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Fields(p As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim f As PivotField,s As String
For Each f In p.PivotFields
s=s & Prop(f,"Name") & "|"
Next
Fields=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Fields=s & "ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function CacheOrder() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim c As PivotCache,s As String
For Each c In ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches
s=s & "[" & Prop(c,"Index") & "," & Prop(c,"SourceData") & "," & Prop(c,"RecordCount") & "]"
Next
CacheOrder=s
Exit Function
Failed:
CacheOrder=s & "ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function PState(c As PivotCache,p As PivotTable) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
PState=Prop(c,"Index") & ":" & Prop(c,"RecordCount") & ":table=" & p.CacheIndex & ":" & CStr(p.DataBodyRange.Cells(1,1).Value2)
Exit Function
Failed:
PState="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function DoRefresh(c As PivotCache) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
c.Refresh
DoRefresh="completed"
Exit Function
Failed:
DoRefresh="ERR:" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,c(1 To 3) As PivotCache,p(1 To 3) As PivotTable,f As PivotField,i As Long,l As Long,s As String
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
For i=1 To 3
l=1+(i-1)*4
ws.Cells(1,l).Value="Key" & i
ws.Cells(1,l+1).Value="N" & i
ws.Cells(2,l).Value="A"
ws.Cells(3,l).Value="B"
ws.Cells(4,l).Value="A"
ws.Cells(2,l+1).Value=i*10
ws.Cells(3,l+1).Value=i*20
ws.Cells(4,l+1).Value=i*30
Set c(i)=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range(ws.Cells(1,l),ws.Cells(4,l+1)))
Set p(i)=c(i).CreatePivotTable(ws.Cells(8,l),"Report" & i)
Set f=p(i).AddDataField(p(i).PivotFields("N" & i),"Total" & i,xlSum)
Next
s="initial=" & CacheOrder()
For i=1 To 3
s=s & ";held" & i & "=" & PState(c(i),p(i))
ws.Cells(2,2+(i-1)*4).Value=i*100
Next
s=s & ";edited=" & CacheOrder()
s=s & ";refresh=" & DoRefresh(c(1)) & ";after=" & CacheOrder()
For i=1 To 3
s=s & ";heldAfter" & i & "=" & PState(c(i),p(i))
Next
s=s & ";repeat=" & DoRefresh(c(1)) & ";afterRepeat=" & CacheOrder()
For i=1 To 3
s=s & ";heldRepeat" & i & "=" & PState(c(i),p(i))
Next
Probe=s
End Function

Dim ws As Worksheet,c As PivotCache,u As PivotCache,p As PivotTable,q As PivotTable,z As PivotTable,f As PivotField,s As String,stage As String,h As PivotField
On Error GoTo Failed
stage="setup"
Set ws=ActiveSheet
ws.Name="Data"
ws.Range("A1:B1").Value=Array("Region","Amount")
ws.Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("East",10)
ws.Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("West",20)
ws.Range("A4:B4").Value=Array("East",30)
ws.Range("J1:K1").Value=Array("Other","Amount")
ws.Range("J2:K2").Value=Array("X",7)
ws.Range("J3:K3").Value=Array("Y",8)
Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:B4"))
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("D3"),"First")
Set f=p.AddDataField(p.PivotFields("Amount"),"Total",xlSum)
Set q=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("G3"),"Shared")
Set f=q.AddDataField(q.PivotFields("Amount"),"Mean",xlAverage)
Set u=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("J1:K3"))
Set z=u.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("M3"),"Unrelated")
Set f=z.AddDataField(z.PivotFields("Amount"),"OtherTotal",xlSum)
Set h=p.PivotFields("Amount")
s="version=" & Application.Version & "|" & Application.Build & ";initial=[" & State(c,u,p,q,z) & "]"
stage="edit"
ws.Range("B2").Value2=100
ws.Range("B4").Value2=300
ws.Range("K2").Value2=70
s=s & ";edited=[" & State(c,u,p,q,z) & "]"
ws.Range("B1").Value="Renamed"
s=s & ";fieldsBefore=" & Fields(p) & ";heldBefore=" & Prop(h,"Name")
stage="first-action"
s=s & ";first=" & Act(c,p) & ";after-first=[" & State(c,u,p,q,z) & "]"
stage="repeat-action"
s=s & ";repeat=" & Act(c,p) & ";after-repeat=[" & State(c,u,p,q,z) & "]"
s=s & ";fieldsAfter=" & Fields(p) & ";heldAfter=" & Prop(h,"Name") & ";order=" & CacheOrder()
Probe=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=s & ";PROBE-ERROR:" & stage & ":" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
